author: real_d1
quote:
The campaign was one of the most difficult, including legendary. Characters participating in the campaign could be better, but the new place was very well done.

Strand needs some buffs, especially on the grapple that takes a long time to come back, I think they should fix that. Also, since the release of the stasis subclass, not everything works out for all classes. But Titan and Warlock already have very strong endgame builds.

Ignore the cries of some haters who probably haven't played the game and don't understand the core of the game (which is the grind, always has been). New activities, new strike, new raid (coming soon) and much more to explore in this new expansion (apart from the new meta).

It's worth playing, for anyone who really understands what the game is about and has probably been playing since D1. Peace!
